item.title: Hyundai plans ₹4,000 crore investment in Maharashtra, aims to double Pune plant capacity by 2030
item.description: Hyundai Motor India will invest an additional ₹4,000 crore in Maharashtra by 2030, gradually expanding its Pune plant’s annual capacity from 1.7 lakh to 3.2 lakh vehicles.

item.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla eyes $30 billion investment amid global uncertainties: ‘You either grow or you go down’
item.description: Kumar Mangalam Birla plans to invest up to $30 billion across the Aditya Birla Group’s businesses over next two to three years, adding about increased spending in the United States. The Aditya Birla Group has operations in 41 countries, reported revenue of $72 billion in financial year ended March.

item.title: Tata Play takes its channel bundle beyond the set-top box
item.description: Tata Play has launched Tata Play Smart with over 500 television channels as smart television moves beyond urban homes.

item.title: Getty Images to go private, planning 'prepackaged' bankruptcy amid $2.1 billion debt- Here's what we know
item.description: Getty Images on Monday said that it has reached an agreement with major lenders to restructure its debt. As of June 30, the company has reported a total debt of $2.1 billion.

item.description: CEO Julie Sweet said the company plans to harness tech modernization, mid-market expansion, and an $8-billion M&amp;A budget to drive long-term growth.

item.title: Reliance enters ready-to-drink dairy category with flavoured Milk at ₹20, to compete with Amul, ITC, Mother Diary
item.description: Reliance Consumer Products launched flavoured milk, Joyland, available in three variants, vanilla, strawberry and pistachio, in Tamil Nadu. It marks their entry into the ready-to-drink dairy beverage sector after the soft-drink market.

item.title: IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax raises job security concerns; Finance Ministry assures staff protection
item.description: Fairfax will acquire a majority stake in IDBI Bank after Cabinet approval, sparking concerns about job security and staff welfare. Here's what the government said in response.

item.title: Netflix layoffs: 1,000 jobs to go as streaming giant expands into ads, live sports and gaming
item.description: Netflix layoffs: Netflix is reportedly planning to cut about 6% of its workforce, or roughly 1,000 jobs, in its biggest round of layoffs since 2022. The reported cuts come as the streaming company expands into advertising, live programming and gaming amid intensifying competition for viewers.

item.title: Emirates cites infrastructure, flying-rights hurdles at Navi Mumbai, seeks more India flying rights
item.description: Emirates said Navi Mumbai needs supporting facilities to attract international carriers, while its India expansion remains constrained by bilateral flying rights.

item.title: IDBI Bank's ₹52,878-crore sale to Fairfax gets govt nod: a 9-year journey from financial crisis to restructuring
item.description: The Union Cabinet approved Fairfax's acquisition of a 60.72% controlling stake in IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 crore. The deal would reduce the government’s and LIC’s stake in the lender. Here's how the restructuring process unfolded over a period of nine years.

item.title: B2B manufacturing startup Scimplify raises $25 mn led by Hitachi Ventures
item.description: The fresh capital will be used to expand Scimplify’s research laboratories, deepen its presence in US and Europe, and strengthen its in-house AI platform SciNode.

item.title: India homecoming: Hyderabad-born Prem Watsa behind Fairfax, the Canadian powerhouse that has bought IDBI
item.description: Prem Watsa, who moved from Hyderabad to Canada at 22 with $8, built Fairfax Financial into a global insurance and investment group. Now valued at around $100 billion in assets, Fairfax is expanding its India presence through the acquisition of IDBI Bank.

item.title: How Jio got to a $3.2bn IPO in 10 years flat — and what lies next with AI
item.description: Jio transformed India’s telecom market with cheap data. Now, as it seeks a $115 billion valuation, can its AI, digital services and satellite ambitions deliver the next wave of growth?

item.title: Lightstorm bets $500 mn on fibre networks to tap India’s AI data centre boom
item.description: The company has spent $500 million on fibre networks, data centre connectivity and subsea cables linking India to the rest of the world

item.title: Air India's A350 engines turning costly? CEO Tewolde Gebremariam looks to reduce soaring maintenance costs
item.description: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam is reportedly seeking to reduce the cost of maintaining the airline’s six A350 aircraft. The airline recorded its highest-ever annual loss of more than 220 billion rupees ($2.3 billion) in the previous financial year.

item.title: India’s holiday rentals scale up as hotel supply lags
item.description: The expansion of alternative accommodation comes as domestic travel gathers pace, creating opportunities for operators that manage holiday rentals.

item.title: Sunil Mittal takes on Elon Musk, says Bharti is ahead of Starlink, ready to launch
item.description: According to Sunil Bharti Mittal, his company is ahead of Starlink in India’s satellite approval queue, with its network and satellites ready but security clearances still pending.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘AI was a monster’: Kumar Mangalam Birla reveals strategy behind investing in artificial intelligence
item.description: Aditya Birla Group chairman Kumar Mangalam Birla says global crises, shifting trade policies and changing demand are complicating investment decisions, but businesses must keep growing.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Zoho's Sridhar Vembu is trending after ‘pay hike, mass layoff’ tweet: Losing 80% clients, making mega business, more
item.description: Vembu started building what came to be known “Zoho” in the 1990s, in a small apartment located in the suburbs of Chennai. The startup had its own share of struggles and achievements. Here's the story of Zoho – how it became a billion-dollar company.

item.title: Who is Neville Tata? Why is he in the news today? Latest developments in Tata Trust dispute explained

item.title: M Pallonji backed Protec General secures around ₹300 crore to expand operations
item.description: The capital infusion follows Protec’s in-principle regulatory approval. Existing investor Federal Bank also participated as the insurer prepares to expand its operations.

item.description: Bank of Baroda responds to BR Shetty's $15 billion lawsuit in the Bombay High Court, saying it has not received court papers. Here's what the case alleges.

item.title: AI startup with 12 million users faces bankruptcy: Why Character.AI failed to make money
item.description: Despite about 12 million active users, Character.AI loses up to $9 million monthly. Disney has agreed to bid $20 million for a licence to its intellectual property.

item.title: Hyundai, TVS ready electric mini-truck to rival Tata Ace in 2027
item.description: The entry will expand TVS’s automotive ambitions beyond two- and three-wheelers, while giving Hyundai a foothold in India’s commercial vehicle market beyond passenger cars.

item.title: Zoho’s pay freeze signals broader AI-led pressures for India’s software industry
item.description: Zoho’s profitability has come under pressure since FY23, the year OpenAI brought generative AI into the mainstream with the launch of ChatGPT in November 2022. While Zoho’s profitability rose 3% in FY23, its employee costs jumped 49%.

item.title: Blackstone in talks to invest $400-500 million in defence tech firm Accord
item.description: Founded in 1991 by five engineers with experience in avionics and real-time embedded systems, Accord has evolved from a software developer into a specialist in global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). It makes satellite navigation devices, specialised computer chips and electronic systems.

item.title: Rising costs put logistics firms under pressure this festive season
item.description: With logistics providers revising rates, brands may increasingly rethink discounting, delivery fees and fulfilment strategies as they navigate margin pressures.
